name: check-postgres
description: Read-only: does the demo PostgreSQL Deployment already exist? Fails on purpose if it does -- that failure is what the workflows branch on.

name: install-postgres
description: Creates the Secret, PVC, Deployment and Service for the demo PostgreSQL in namespace ansible-demo. Idempotent.

name: delete-postgres
description: Deletes the demo PostgreSQL's Deployment, Service, PVC and credentials Secret. Only ever launched after a Workflow Approval node.
